messages.subject: qtbase build problems on FreeBSD
parts:
Dear list,

I am not sure if this is the right place for asking about package qtbase.

I try to build and install qtbase from sources (qtbase_1.1.0.tar.gz) on
FreeBSD 10.0-CURRENT (amd64) without success. It seems, there is some
trouble with Qt OpenGL headers (at least GL/gl.h and GL/glu.h are not
found, but installed in /usr/local/include/GL).

Qt 4.7.4 is installed on my FreeBSD box and other software like
stellarium and openuniverse (also build from sources) works fine with
this installation of Qt OpenGL.

Any help is really appreciated. The messages around the build failure
are appended. Please let me know if I should provide more information.

Thanks in advance,
Rainer Hurling
